workload.transport: HTTP/1.1 over TLS, one reusable connection per worker
workload.kgateway: Kense Key, durable quota and usage, sensitive admission with separate audit witness, then kstack mTLS
workload.kstack-direct: private mTLS listener with preissued service credentials and matched usage starts
workload.percentile: nearest-rank P99 over all measured requests; warmup excluded
